Rafa (CS): Creating a tiny 'FastPass' kickoff checklist AMs can paste into trial notes. Goal: reduce first-response latency, limit token burn, and surface renewal signals in 7 days.
Bea (Solutions): Nice name. Can we include a single prefill command, a cost-safety knob, and a 7-day pulse rule?
Rafa (CS): Yep. Topline pasteable checklist (2 mins):
Rafa (CS): - Idempotent prefill: templates + last_20 messages (run once).
Rafa (CS): - Reserve warm pool: 2 sessions for first 18h, then scale down.
Rafa (CS): - Client retry: 3x with exponential jitter. Enable streaming fallback.
Rafa (CS): - Capture 8 eval prompts and send quick feedback link.
Chris (SRE): Ops notes: set warm_pool.min_replicas=2 for 18h -> then min=0. Healthcheck GET /healthz after pool creation. Prefill must include idempotency_key to avoid duplicate token burn.
Bea (Solutions): One-line prefill (pasteable):
Bea (Solutions): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"FASTPASS_01","idempotency_key":"fastpass-$(date +%s)","items":[{"type":"template","name":"welcome_v3"},{"type":"history","last_n":20}]}'
```
Chris (SRE): Cost-safety: set unit_cost_threshold=$0.0008/token; if exceeded, enable quantized model fallback and reduce batch_size. Also cap prefill_items to last_n<=20.
Lena (PM): 7-day pulse rule: if active_queries_day7 < 0.4 * avg(active_day1-3) OR avg_response_time_day7 > 1.2s -> flag renewal-risk and schedule enablement.
Rafa (CS): Customer-facing blurb to paste: "We ran a light prefill to speed up your first replies and reserved a small pool for the first day. Reply if you'd rather we don't run this."
Bea (Solutions): Telemetry thresholds to add: 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR streaming_error_rate >1% OR p99_stream_latency > 1200ms -> route to #oncall-infra and tag AM. Track prefill_failures by tenant.
Chris (SRE): Demo tip: ask oncall-bot to mute deploy noise for the tenant during demos: `oncall-bot silence deploys 30m tenant:FASTPASS_01`
oncall-bot: OK 52345478 deploy alerts muted for 30 minutes for tenant:FASTPASS_01 :white_check_mark:
Rafa (CS): I'll add this FastPass one-pager + curl to CS templates and link it from the renewal playbook as "Kickoff FastPass + day7 pulse." Thanks all. :raised_hands:
